dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical 2D narrowing from the maximum width of the mid-dorsal region toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Smooth lateral margins with no discernible localized bulges or indentations visible at the current resolution.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light-grey to off-white median intensity across the dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse grey patches distributed primarily across the posterior dorsal and lateral surfaces.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient transitions between the light-grey baseline and darker mottled regions.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced, high-reflectance longitudinal dorsal ridge visible along the posterior half of the axial centerline.
